=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- Requirement: The sync script should handle newly added template files that do not yet have corresponding live copies under .claude/.
  Expected change site: scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:72-82 (paired_paths function)
  Evidence of absence: The paired_paths() function filters on `(root / LIVE_PREFIX / relative).is_file()`, which excludes any template that does not already exist as a live file. When a new command or hook file is added under workflow-templates/.claude/, the sync script will never plan or sync it into .claude/. The parity test test_live_copies_match_their_templates() would fail, but the sync workflow would not automatically fix it. The PR description states "When the push changed a template but not its live copy, it copies the template over" — this implies the live copy must already exist. New templates require manual bootstrapping. This is a design limitation: the sync script keeps existing pairs in sync, but does not bootstrap new ones. The parity test catches the gap, but operators must manually create the live copy.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
